api: real Identity jar + real Notification, Resend stand-in

results.id: L1 360: the whole sign-up, step by step, creates a verified account and lands on the first step of the invitation
L2 360: MV-D3 the screen after asking for a code is identical for a new and an existing address, in a real browser
L3 360: MV-D3 a wrong code says the same thing for a new and an existing address; the person can ask for another
L4 360: MV-D3 "ya tengo cuenta" opens /login with the typed e-mail already there and NOT in the URL
L5 360: focus moves to each step and it is announced; the progress bar tells where the person is
L6 360: the action is always reachable (fixed bar on a phone) and the page never scrolls sideways
L7 360: reduced motion: a step swaps with no slide and the task works the same
L8 360: axe finds no critical or serious violation on any step or on the code screen (light and dark)
L9 360: the draft is only in memory: a reload starts over and nothing of it is in storage or the URL
L10 360: the terms are required on step 4 and the page for them can be opened and left without losing the verified e-mail
L11 360: INJECTED 429 from the gateway: the wait is shown and the e-mail typed is kept
L12 360: the wrong-code path of five attempts ends the code (real Identity), and a new code works
